levelText.tunnel: The U2 runs in a tunnel under your feet here.
levelText.ramp: The U2 is climbing out of the ground in the middle of the street. Approximate position.
levelText.viaduct: The U2 runs over your head on the green steel viaduct of 1913.

stops.name: U Senefelderplatz
stops.here: The last underground station before the line comes up. In late November 2026 trains towards Pankow were not stopping here (checked 26 November); start at Eberswalder Straße or check the BVG app on the day.

stops.name: Jewish Cemetery Schönhauser Allee
stops.here: Laid out in 1827. Max Liebermann and Giacomo Meyerbeer are buried here. Mon to Thu 8:00 to 16:00, Fri 7:30 to 13:00, closed Saturday, Sunday and Jewish holidays (berlin.de).

stops.name: Where the train comes up
stops.here: Stand at the edge of the middle strip and wait for a yellow train to rise out of the ground and onto the viaduct. Approximate position.

stops.name: Kulturbrauerei (Lucia Christmas market)
stops.here: The old Schultheiss brewery, red brick from 1878 on. The Lucia Christmas market runs in its courtyards from 23 November to 22 December 2026, free, weekdays 15:00 to 22:00, weekends 13:00 to 22:00.

stops.name: Konnopke's Imbiss
stops.here: Currywurst stand under the tracks since 1930, ohne Darm since 1960. Tue to Fri 11:00 to 18:00, Sat 12:00 to 19:00, closed Sunday and Monday.

stops.name: U Eberswalder Straße
stops.here: The elevated station of 1913, opened as Danziger Straße. Climb to the platform and look down the street both ways.

stops.name: Mauerpark
stops.here: About 430 m west along Eberswalder Straße, on the former border strip. Busiest on a Sunday, when the flea market runs.

stops.name: Gethsemanekirche
stops.here: Down Stargarder Straße. From 2 October 1989 people held a vigil here for arrested protesters, weeks before the Wall fell.

stops.name: S+U Schönhauser Allee
stops.here: The U2 platform sits above the Ringbahn cutting. The north entrance is closed for bridge works since 13 November 2026, until about spring 2027; the other entrances are open.
